visualCharacteristics.structure: image + heading + text + field + button + list
visualCharacteristics.purpose: searchable A-Z glossary: intro card (title, disclaimer, sub heading, search field) over a background image, a vertical letter tab list, and term/definition rows for the selected letter

contentPattern.structure: optional first row with only a background image; single-cell rows before the terms are the intro (title, disclaimer, sub heading); then one row per term with the term in the first cell and the definition in the second (a single cell starting with a bold 'Term:' also works). Optional key/value rows: Search (search field label), No results (empty-state text). Single-cell rows after the terms are appended below (a /fragments/ link is loaded in place). Letter tabs are generated from the terms

usage: Use for the glossary of financial terms page. Author terms in any order; they are grouped by first letter and only letters with terms get a tab. Searching filters across all letters.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any A-Z term list or FAQ index. For a short list without search or letter tabs, use an accordion or default content.
